title: PR #14: feat: introduce native A-TownChain Layer 2 architecture
content:
State: open
Merged: False

## Summary
Implements and documents the first executable ATC-L2 core.

### Implemented
- deterministic Rust L2 state machine
- native fungible token lifecycle
- L1 deposit/withdrawal references with replay protection
- deterministic state roots
- deterministic L2 batches and receipts
- L1 settlement commitment data model
- workspace integration
- CI coverage for the new L2 crate
- architecture and protocol documentation

### Explicit boundary
This PR does not claim ZK validity, permissionless sequencing, durable L2 recovery, or final L1 settlement execution. Those are subsequent integration stages.

Flow:
ATCLang -> ATC-VM -> ATC-L2 -> state root -> A-TownChain L1 settlement.
